item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"waiting_requests","expression":"len(self.waiting) + len(self.skipped_waiting)","rationale":"Captures per-request queue traversal, admission checks, and scheduling bookkeeping."},{"name":"waiting_blocks","expression":"sum((r.num_tokens + self.block_size - 1) // self.block_size for r in self.waiting)","rationale":"Estimates block allocation and prefix-cache processing work across waiting requests."},{"name":"priority_queue_work","expression":"len(self.waiting) * len(self.waiting).bit_length()","rationale":"Models the additional heap work from draining the priority queue."}],"hypothesis":"The workload admits small waiting batches with ample token and request capacity.
